/rnal 'byor bzhi'i gnad kyi nying khu rdzogs so// // 676) ༄// rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams// na mo gu ru/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ rje btsun chen po yan chad du rnal 'byor bzhir phye ba'i zhal gsal ni med de/ rje dwags po rin po che 'jig rten du byon nas/ sgom chen pa'i nang rtogs tshod dang sa lam dang bstun nas smras pa yin/ nyams rnal 'byor bzhir phye ba yin/ de la dpal phag mo gru pas bka' yig mdzad pas nyams rnal 'byor bzhi che 'bring chung gsum du byung ba yin/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams mar grags pa bu slob gzhan la med pa zhig slob dpon dwags po sgom chung de la yod zer ba gsan nas yod pa la/ phyis e chung dgon phug na bzhugs pa'i dus su sgom skyon drag po zhig byung ba la/ slob dpon rtsi lung pa lam 'bras mkhan po yin pas lam 'bras man ngag zhus pas phyag dpe la gzigs shing gsung bar 'dug phan par ni ma byung*/ jo mo lha rje ma'i gdams ngag cig bsgoms pas skyed en cig byung*/ gtsang du bzhud dgongs pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa zhig byung nas log nas byon pa dang*/ slob dpon dwags po sgom chung ba de lha sar bzhugs zer ba gsan nas lha sar byon/ jo bo rnam gnyis la bla ma rin po che sgom gyin bskor ba byas pas sku khams la skyed en tsam zhig byung*/ slob dpon sgom chung la mjal bar zhus pas nyi ma gnyis su mjal bar ma byung*/ nyi ma gsum pa la song nas de ring chos zhu dgos byas pas/ nye gnas de nang du song ba dang*/ nye gnas sam mi gzhon 'dra ba phrin yang bsha' ma e zlo'am snyam nas sgo rtsar byon nas gsan pas nye gnas des phrin bsha' mar byed kyin 'dug pa dang*/ sang mjal dgos gsung gin 'dug pa la/ nye gnas de khro yin 'dug pas/ mi dad pa can chos zhu ba nyi ma'i rigs la zlog nas cugs kyang rang chang la brtsi drags pa yin zer gyin 'dug pa dang*/

'o na 'di kun sdus la nang du thong gsung gin 'dug pa dang*/ da mjal bar 'dug gam snyam nas da ci'i sa der 'khrul 'khor du lam mer bzhugs pa dang*/ da nang du byon zer nas nang du byon pa dang*/ skyil krung du lam mer bzhugs nas 'dug khab skud zung gcig phyag rten du byas nas rnal 'byor bzhi'-i zhal gdams mar grags pa zhig bu slob gzhan la med pa zhig yod par gda' bas/ de cis kyang gnang bar zhu zhes zhus pas/ 'o gang nas 'ongs gsungs pas/ dpal gyi phag mo gru nas 'ongs zhus/ dpal phag mo gru pa sangs rgyas yin/ phag mo gru nas 'ongs pa sangs rgyas kyi phrug gu yin/ chos de khyod la bya gsung*/ slob dpon sgom chung gi zhal snga nas/ de la 'o skol gyi bka' brgyud 'di'i dbang du byas na/ dang po ma smin pa smin par byed pa la dbang bskur nas de nas yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa rab zla ba gsum/ 'bring zla ba gnyis/ tha ma yang zla ba phyed kyi bar bsnyen pas sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags 'ong*/ de nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos gzhi 'debs/ dang po la lan gsum du bskyar ba de bla ma la byin rlabs yod na slob ma la 'jug pa'i rten 'brel gyi che ba yin gsung*/ de nas nyams blta bdun song ba dang*/ bogs 'don zla ba phyed kyi bar du las khur drag po yang dag pa byed/ nga chen po yin snyam nas las khur ma byas na ngo 'phrod pa shin du dka' gsung*/ zla ba phyed song ba dang*/ yod na ja la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur yang bya/ de nas bla ma'i snyan pa'i gsung gis phul ded la sogs pas ngo sprad pas rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor rgyud la skye/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor de la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad lhan gyis zhi/ de la rtse gcig tu gnas dge sbyor de rang gis gang yin mi shes gsung*/ de'i dus su ngo bo de nyid rang la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes kyis mos gus byas pas rtse gcig gi dge sbyor de'i ngo bo de phar ma shor tshur ma lus/

yar ma shor mar ma lus par/ ngo bo nyid kho na spros bral gyi rtogs pa lhag gis 'char/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang rjes kyi shes pa gnyis shan shag gis phyed/ mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ ngo bo de nyid la rtse gcig tu gnas rjes rnam par rtog pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs su skye/ de'i dus su mnyam gzhag de rjes ma yin/ rjes de mnyam gzhag ma yin gsung*/ de'i dus su'ang ngo bo nyid rang la mnyam par bzhag cing bla ma la mos gus byas pas/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'char/ ro gcig de dpe ci dang 'dra snyam na/ la kha'i na bun dang 'dra gsung*/ la kha'i na bun de'ang mngon sum du na bun thul lu lu byed kyin 'dug kyang dngos su grub pa ni rdul tsam yang med pa gsung*/ de bzhin du ro gcig rtogs pa de'ang skye ba'i cha ni yod/ skyes pa de nyid phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig tu rtogs/ de'i dus su ngo bo nyid de la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ bla ma la mos gus byas pas/ sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba de rgyud la 'char ba yin gsung*/ 'di'i dus su mnyam gzhag dang rjes gnyis med de/ mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig yin gsung*/ 'di'i dus su rje btsun chen po mi la'i tshad du slebs pa yin gsung*/ skye med phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig yin gsung*/ rje btsun chen po'ang dge sbyor 'di'i ngang la bzhugs pa yin gsung*/ ngo sprod 'di las zab pa med gsung*/ thugs kyi dgongs pa la chos 'di lta bu zab drags zhal du 'don phod pa dgongs pa dang*/ 'on du lags kyang dwags po rin po che sku na so byon/ sku gshegs pa la thug pa dang*/ dbon po gcung yang sku na gzhon ches pa thugs kyis ma bzod nges nas gnang ba'i rigs su 'dug slob dpon 'dis nga la brnyas bcos ma byas chos de gsha' mar thugs la btags/ 'on du lags kyang chos 'di 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa nyid la gsan pa yin ang snyam/ 'on du lags kyang slob dpon des gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob nus pa zhig 'dug

de'i rgyu mtshan/ phyis khong sku gshegs nas/ spur khang ka ba bzhi btsugs pa zhig gi steng du spur bzhu yin 'dug pa dang*/ spur khang nas thugs de ma tshig par rjen par kho bo'i pang par rgyang gis byon pa dang*/ thaid tshe re skyug bro snyam nas thu ba sprugs pa zhig rmis/ byin rlabs de 'jug par byung ba la len ma shes/ de cis lan na/ dpal phag mo gru pa'am/ bla ma gong ma min pa'i bla ma gzhan gyi byin rlabs skyug bro/ dgos pa med snyam pa'i thugs kyi bcad pa chen po des lan 'dug rje rin po ches rnal 'byor chos g.yung can na blo gnas shig mdzad kyin bzhugs nas yod pa'i dus su chos kyi dri ba 'dra ba mdzad pa la ye sba gsang mi mdzad par gsung bar 'dug pas/ zhu ba mdzad de dri ba bag tsam la'ang chos rnams thig le nag shad du gsung bar 'dug pa/ 'di yi rgyu mtshan ji ltar lags zhus pas/ he mos gus mi byed pa rnams la thig le nag shad du bshad pas khong mos gus skye ba yin gsung*/ khong gis nga'i bsam pa mkhyen par 'dug snyam nas chos 'brel zhus pa yin gsung*/ mdor na slob dpon dwags po sgom chung dang rnal 'byor chos g.yung gnyis la thugs rtsis che ba yin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams ma rdzogs so/// / 677) ༄// rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams chen mo// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir rang gzhan 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ chos la ris su mi bcad cing*/ bzang ngan du mi blta ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsung pa thams cad kyang*/ kun rdzob tu sems can gyi khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa tha dad pa la dgongs nas gsungs pas/ 'di bden 'di mi bden med/ 'di chos yin 'di chos min du spyad na/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab yin pas/

lam 'phrang bshig pa dang 'dra ste/ de skad du'ang*/ chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// ces pa dang*/ nad pa dang ni nad pa la// sman pas rdzas byin ji lta bar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// sems tsam du yang bshad pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi brjod bya mthar thug snying rje dang stong pa nyid yin no// de ma gsungs pa'i sde snod gang yang med pas/ lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /de bzhin du ni rang rgyal gyi// theg pa sna tshogs ngas bshad pa// byis pa rnams ni yongs drang phyir// theg pa rnams la thug pa med// de bas theg pa gcig tu bstan// ces gsung pas// zab mo'i don la ma mos pa dang*/ theg pa chen po spong ba dang*// dam chos 'drar snang ston par 'gro// chos la ris dang phyogs su mi bcad/ 'o na rang gis nyams su blang rgyu'i chos de gang yin zhe na/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// zhes pa dang*/ rang gi sems nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi dbang du song ba nyid bsal ba'i thabs gang yin pa de nyid/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyams su blang ba'i chos su gsungs kyi/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa thams cad kyang*/ nyon mongs pa'i grogs dang rgyur song na/ skyes bu kho rang gi bsam pa la ltos nas chos su ma song bas/ byas pa don med du song ste/ sbrul la 'o ma blud pa ni// dug 'phel 'gyur ba kho nar zad// ces pa dang*/ chos kyi sku thob par byed pa'i rgyu mthun par byed pa yin pas/ kā ri ka nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar gyi gsung rab la mos gus byas na chos kyi sku dang mjal ba la tshegs med/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje yi ge'i rnam par gdul bya rnams la snang bas/ tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig la'ang*/ gdul bya tha dad pa go ba tha dad par shar nas 'ong bas so// de'ang sangs rgyas thob par byed pa sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos te/

nyan thos kyi sdom pa dang mi ldan na gzhan la gnod pa byed cing kun da nyams nas 'gro/ de'ang byang chub kyi sems la gnod/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi ldan/ gzhan don byed pa'i mthu chung bas sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus med/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa dang mi ldan na/ mtshan ma dang dngos pos zil gyis non cing rang sems mi shes pas chos sku thob pa la rgyab kyis phyaugs/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing dben pa'i gnas su 'bol ba'i stan bting*/ mthun pa'i grogs dang 'grogs te/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum la yid ches pa'i sgo nas mchod pa rgya chen po bya zhing*/ yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag rin po che la/ sgrub pa g.yos legs pa'i kha zas za ba bzhin du byas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu bzhin du 'bras bu 'byin par tshegs med/ yang gnyis par na gang zag la skur ba mi gdab ste/ byang chub sems dpa' gang yin cha med pas/ gtan sdug gi gnas su 'gro ba la tshegs med cing rang gis rang mgo bskor ba'i bslus 'debs pa la tshegs med/ theg pa chung ngu'i dbang du byas na/ dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi dang bral/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas na/ bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa'i rtsa ltung 'ong*/ byang chub sems dpas lus la mi 'jog sems la 'jog mngon shes med pa rnams kyis sems kyi spu ris rtogs pa dka'/ byang chub sems dpa' yin na bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i dge ba 'dzad par 'gro dogs yod/ rang gi sems la ci yod kyi bla ma dang grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dang*/ sems can gzhan la dpag shi byas na/ dang po 'grogs mi bde/ bar du sems mi mthun/ mtha' ma lus ngag tu thon nas ngan song gi rgyu byed/ spyir gzhan gyi bya spyod la yid gnyis dang the tshom du byed/ log pa byed nges su mi bsam/ bram ze mo dang ne'u le mo// bsam pa mi mthun de bzhin no// gang dang gang mthong ba thams cad kyang yi dam dang bla mar byas na/

tshe 'di la mi mthun pa'i rkyen zhi zhing*/ bar ma dor sangs rgyas dang mjal/ phyi mar sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su skye/ spyir sems can gzhan gyi 'khrul pa la mi brtag rang gi nyes skyon du bsam/ chu la lhas bdud rtsir mthong ba la sogs pa bzhin no// chos byed zer nas kyang*/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mgo la thod bzhin du khur na gzod/ byang chub sems dpa' yin gyis/ sems can 'di rnams ni ngan/ 'di rnams ni bzang zhes mtho dman du byed na khra dang spyang ki'i rjes dang 'dra ste/ de tshod tsam zhig byi bo dbyug thogs la'ang yod/ bla ma dam pa man chad/ 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad kyi skyon ma bsgom shing yon tan bsams na/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yon tan bum pa gang byo'i tshul du 'ong ba la tshegs med/ gsha' mar byang chub kyi sems bsgom nas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu thams cad bdag nyid gcig pus bya dgos pa la/ mtho ste mtho na bla ma'i yon tan la phrag dog dma' ste dma' na tha mal gyi phun sum tshogs pa sems khong nas 'khrugs par grogs po rnams kyi spyod pa la ma legs par blta na/ byang chub sems dpa' dang 'gal/ gzhan gyi nyes skyon du ma brjod cing*/ snying nas smad na sems can gyi don mi 'grub/ dge ba byas kyang 'bras bu lha ma yin du skye/ nga rgyal gyi stobs kyis rang gi yon tan la rlom na rang gi bla ma dam pa mi 'dud cing gdams ngag dang mi phrad/ bar du lam nyams su blangs kyang ting 'dzin rgyud la mi skye/ phub ma brdungs pa dang 'dra/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis nyams yal yul byung yang srin bu'i kha chus 'thums pa bzhin du khams gsum 'khor ba las mi 'da'o// bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam rgyud la skyes kyang*/ rang sangs rgyas las 'da' mi srid/ de skad du yang*/

nga rgyal gyis ni yon tan bar chad lam mchog yon tan skye mi srid// yon tan rgya mtsho nga rgyal sgang bur chags pa med// ces pa dang*/ nga rgyal bral bas bden pa mthong bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa nyon mongs pa tsam la skyon du ma bltas na/ mngon mtho dang nges legs thob pa'i thabs med/ ting nge 'dzin rgyud la mi skye/ skyes kyang kha zas dug dang bcas pa dang 'dra ste/ mtshan brjod las/ nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs shing*// mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi// zhes pas mngon no// yang nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i sems kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom na chu rnyog ma dang bcas pa la gzugs brnyan mi gsal ba bzhin du/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod kyang sprul pa'i zhal mi mthong*/ tshogs lam chen mo bgrod mi nus/ dad pa ma brtan na nyams la sgang gshong 'ong zhing dbang po lnga rgyud la mi skye/ de ma skyes na don dam pa'i bden pa la nges shes dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'ong du mi 'dod/ chos nyid la nges pa khyad par can gyi ting nge 'dzin ma skyes na/ sa lam rgyud la mi skye/ de ma skyes na ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'bras bu sku gsum thob pa la gegs byed/ chos thams cad rim gyis skyes na bram ze chen po sa ra has tshig gcig bsgom pas thun cig gis sangs rgyas pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis thun gcig mnyan nas thun gcig bsgom pas mthong lam thob pa dang*/ rje bi ru pa dang*/ dpal tog tse pa la sogs pas/ dbang bzhi nub gcig la bskur bas de nyid kyi dus su mchog gi dngos grub mthar thug thob pa la sogs pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ de'ang snga ma tshogs bsags shing*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes rgyun ma 'chad pa las byung gis/ bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag dang bla ma la the tshom dang yid gnyis skyes na 'bras bu thob pa'i thabs med de/ mai tri che chung gis yid gnyis dang the tshom skyes pas tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i gegs su gyur/

the tshom med par ci gsung dang ci mdzad thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad spyod du go bas/ dpal nā ro pa bzhin du mchog thun mong gi dngos grub la tshegs med/ lar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed pa la/ bla ma gnad che/ gsang sngags kyi lam bla ma dang pho nya yin/ rang nyid kyis bsnyen bkur ram grags snyan bag tsam la ltos nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su ma byas nas/ nyes skyon brjod nas ltung ba rdzogs na thon pa'i thabs med/ nyes byas la sogs pa byung nas ma bshags na ltung ba rang 'gro/ bshags pa byas nas mos gus mtho dman tsam byung na bla ma dang 'phrad pa'i dus med/ 'o na nged so so'i skye bo la nyes pa byung na bla ma la mi bsten nam zhe na/ bsten dgos te skyes bu dam pa ni gnyis te/ dang po nyes pa ma byung ba/ gnyis pa byung ba phyir bcos pa'o// theg pa chen po sdom pa'i bslab bya thams cad rin po che'i snod zhom pa dang 'dra ste/ legs par bcos na sngar bas kyang bzang bar 'ong ste/ rgyal po dpa' sbyin bzhin no// bla ma la bsten pa'i tshul ji ltar zhe na/ ha cang nye min ring ba min// rtag tu 'bral bar mi bya'o// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la// sangs rgyas sku gsum blta bar bya// bltas pas sku gsum thob par 'gyur// de ltar chos dang sems can dang bla ma la mos gus gzhung nas grags pa bzhin du gnas gar bya zhe na/ las dang po pa'i gnas ni nyin par skye bo'i rgyu 'grul gyis dben pa/ mtshan mo sgras klag cor chung bar bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag par bya ste/ yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab kyi don thun gcig gi nang du tshang bar bsgom la/ skyo ba med pa'i yid kyis// mtho dman med pa'i sems la// bde sdug spangs pa'i dran pa// zhen pa med pa'i sgron mes// sku gsum rang chas kyi zhal ngo*// shes rab dbang po'i spyan gyis// sprin dang bral ba'i sems la// re dogs med pa'i yid de// 'dod pa'i rlung gis ma bskyod// bzhag rgyu med par bzhag cing*// blta rgyu med par bltas la// lhod kyis glod la mdzo rmed bzhin du bzhag

/gsal la dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin du bzhag /dro la 'bol ba dar mdud bzhin du dgrol// gnyis med thug phrad kyi rang bzhin la// 'das dang ma 'ongs kyi dran pa dag /gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gis mi bslad 'tshal// re dogs kyi g.yang sar mi mchong 'tshal// 'khor gyi drod la mi shor 'tshal// 'dod pa'i gdos thag gis mi bcing 'tshal// kha zas kyi mchil pas

lcags kyu mi bzung 'tshal// rmi lam thun cig myong ba bzhin// 'chi ba'i dus su ya re nga*// gdams ngag rgya mtsho chen po de// 'dod pa'i dug gis mi bslad 'tshal// nyams myong skye ba'i dgon pa de// 'du 'dzi'i sbur mas mi dgang 'tshal// tshe thung nad mang gi dal 'byor 'di// sos dal le lo'i dbang mi btang*// gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// ku re dpag shi bgyis pa lags// theg pa chen po gsang sngags nyams su len pa'i dus su/ spyod pa bzhi dang sbyor ba gal che/ las dang po'i dus su rgyal bu gzhon nu lta bu'i sems bkol ba las su rung ba'i 'go btsugs pa nas gsang sngags kyi spyod pa gal che/ thabs gang ltar byas kyang gting bogs ma thon na rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gal che/ bogs thon nas bde ba rgyun mi bsring bar shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa zhes sam/ smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyi zhes sam/ shing lo rlung gis khyer ba ltar re dogs dang nyams nga thams cad dang bral ba spangs thob dang bzang ngan thams cad dang bral ba zhi ba lha lta bur bya'o// mtshan brjod las/ phyag rgya bzhi yi don ston pa// zhes pa dang*/ mi mthun pa ma yin nam zhe na/ las kyi phyag rgya ni nyan thos ltar na/ lus ngag yid gsum chos rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang mi 'gal ba/ byang chub sems dpa' ltar na/ lus ngag yid gsum pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang mi 'gal ba/ gsang sngags ltar na pho nya dang mi 'gal ba'o// da chos kyi phyag rgya ni nyan thos ltar na gang zag gi bdag med dang mi 'bral ba/ byang chub sems dpa' ltar na sgyu ma spros bral dang mi 'bral ba/ gsang sngags ltar na rlung sems kha sbyor dang mi 'bral ba'o// ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni nyan thos ltar na nyon mongs pa dang ldan ma myong*/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi ngos nas bzhag byang chub sems dpa' ltar na rang don dang ldan ma myong ba'o// gsang sngags ltar na rang 'od kyi rig ma dang bcas pa nyid do// phyag rgya chen po ni/

nyan thos ltar na/ mar me shi bar gyur pa ltar// rang gi sems ni rnam par thar// zhes pas bstan/ mtsho las 'khyags pa zhu ba'am/ nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar gyur pa ni phyag rgya chen po'o// byang chub sems dpa' ltar na/ snying rje dang stong pa ro mnyam pa'o// gsang sngags ltar na grub mtha' de dag thams cad 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ spang bya dang*/ gnyen po la sogs pa thams cad kyang rang gi sems yin la/ sems de nyid la thogs pa med pa'i byang chub kyi sems sam/ rdo rje ye shes sam/ spangs thob dang bral ba zhe'am/ lhan cig skyes pa zhes ming gis btags kyang*/ don tha dad med par smra bsam brjod las 'das par/ sgom chen rnams kyi nyams myong gis shes shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag dpang por nges so// 'o na rang gi nyams myong ji ltar bskyang zhe na/ las dang po pas dben pa'i sar bsdad cing*/ rjes kyi dus su blo ldog bzhi la nges pa ci skye bya/ nges pa ma skyes na tshe 'di'i rlung gis khyer nas nyams myong bskyang mi khom/ rang nyid ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig don du gnyer yang*/ grogs ngan pa tha snyad dang tshig 'ba' zhig la dga' ba/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i blo med pa rnyed bkur 'ba' zhig dmigs pa dang 'grogs na'ang ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i thabs med/ sde 'khrug la sogs pa'i zhe sdang 'ba' zhig skye ba'i gnas su yang ting nge 'dzin 'phel dka'/ de lta bur rang mi sdod dbang med na yang*/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs gang yang rung ba'i sku chen po zhig gi thugs kar bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa gnas par dus rtag tu bsgom/ byams snying rje dang bral ba'i thabs med/ byams pa dang snying rje btang snyoms tsam du gyur na yang gnas dang grogs kyi grib kyis sems rtsub nas 'ong*/ ting nge 'dzin la nyams bag tsam med kyang mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong la sogs pa mi dgyes nas 'ong*/

gzhan la phan stobs chung byams snying rje gtan shor na tshe dang srog gi bar chad du 'gro/ byams pa dang snying rje shin tu gces so// de'i dus su rnal 'byor dang po rtse gcig skyong na yi ge brgya pa'i rten 'brel gyi gzungs chog bya/ rang gar 'dug pa'i mal dang mchod rdzas la sogs pa yang yang gsang bar bya/ gnas de nyid ma ga dhar mos pa yang yang bya/ gtor ma rgya chen po re re bcas la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams thibs kyis byon par bsam/ thun ma thon gyi bar du gtor ma btang zhing*/ bsrung 'khor dang yi dam lha'i bzlas pa tshan gcig bya/ de nas rnal 'byor dang po bsgom/ bsgoms pas shes pa long nge byung na cung zad drags pas kha zas sam/ rang bzhin gyis ngal gso/ yun mi ring bar bya/ de nas yang bsgom/ thun 'go la bying nge 'dug yid mi dga' na/ phyi rol gyi bdud yin pas bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing sems su shes pas chog de ltar byas kyang bying nge 'dug na las kyi stobs chung ba'am 'chi ltas yin srid pas/ dge sbyor sngar bas nyis ldab tu bya/ da rung bying na sems 'dzin ma shes pas ma bcos pa la zhog /ces bskyar/ da rung bying bar 'dug na dam tshig gi sel yod pas bla ma bzhugs na dngos su dbang bskur zhu/ mi bzhugs na rang gis ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhag gsum tsam gyi bar du nus tshad bya/ des sol nas 'ong*/ yang rang nyid ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su sems rnam rtog 'ba' zhig tu gyur na rlung skyes pa srid pas/ mgo'i mtshog bsrubs rkang lag gi mthil bzhi dang rgyab kyi gzhung rigs su byug pa bya/ de nas shes pa glod la bzhag da rung 'phro na rtsa g.yas par rlung sems 'dus pas/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems phab nas rtsa gsum gang bar yang yang du bsgom/ des kyang ma zhi nas khyad par bla ma la bzang ngan gyi rtog pa byung na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhas bar du gcod pa yin pas dgra zun du byed pa dang 'dra ste/

de nyid la byams pa thun che ba zhig bsgom/ thos bsam gyi yul du byas pa'i shes bya thams cad stong pa nyid du spros pa bya/ 'di phyi rol yin snyam du nges shes bskyed cing dben pa 'ba' zhig tu bsdad/ bla ma skyon du 'ong khong gis kyang de tsam bya rgyu mi rnyed de 'ong*/ bla ma dang phrad na slar mos gus log ste 'ong snyam na bdud kyi cher byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ de nyid kyis bla ma dam pa dang myur du 'phrad dgos/ bla ma des ma shes na phyag 'tshal skor ba bya zhing rang gang 'dod kyi gtam dang lo rgyus bya/ bla mas de'i lan legs par bslan na dad pa bag tsam skyes pas kho'i mgo non nas 'ong*/ rang nyid kyis kyang phyi rol bdud yin par shes par byas la nan tan gyis bla ma dang rdo rje 'dzin pa tha dad med par yang yang bsgom/ bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug gis rgyal po mngags nas bar chad byed du btang na/ bla ma de la 'gong po gdon pa bzhin byed du slar 'ong*/ bla ma la khro tshig can du go nas 'ong*/ dga' rab dbang phyug gis mo 'dre gang yang rung ba rang la bar chad byed du btang nas sems de'ang sngar dang mi 'dra bar/ 'dod chags cher song zin bud med la dga' bar 'dug snyam du sems pa 'ong*/ dga' rab dbang phyug des sa bdag la sogs pa btang nas rang nyid la bar du bcad nas rang nyid la bar chad du bzhugs nas/ nga'i bla ma 'di sngon las le lo che/ gnyid cher song snyam du sems zhing mi gus pa dang mi mos pa du ma 'byung*/ yang bdud des mi'am ci'i rgyal po bar chad la btang na/ bla ma de phrag dog che ba dang gzhan gyi yon tan la smod pa'i rnam pa can du 'ong*/ yang 'di rang nga la gnod/ 'di rang 'dre'am bdud chen po yin snyam pa 'ong gsungs so// yi dwags kyi rigs shin tu 'jungs pa 'ga' zhig bar chad byed du btang na/ bla ma 'di rdzas yo byad la dga' ba'am ser sna che bar 'dug snyam pa'i bsam pa 'ong*/

bla ma de la nam ma dad pa'i dus su mi ma yin pa gzhan la'ang brten nas/ skyes bu 'di ni dge sbyor byed kyang bla ma la 'khu bar 'dug pas zhes buddha'i bka' srung phra mo rnams kyi drung du 'gro nas brjod/ des chos skyong chen po rnams kyi rtsar phyin nas da lta kho'i 'dug tshul smras pas/ da lta kho rang nyon mongs pa dang rjes su 'brel bas sangs rgyas kyi bka' srung rnams kyis che srog dang 'bral/ 'bring na tsha bskyed/ tha ma'ang dgos pa'i don mi 'grub par byed/ de ltar byas pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi thob/ de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni// bla ma la ni yon phul la// zhes gsungs shing*/ bsrung ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa bla ma'i mos gus yin/ bar chad sel ba'ang de nyid yin/ sngags pa rnams kyis gzhan la brubs byed pa'i dus su'ang lha dang bla ma dbyen byas kho mi ma yin pa gzhan la stobs pa yin gyi/ de ltar ma yin bar chad byed pa'i kho la nus mthu med do// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs na/ dang por chos byed pa'i blo skye/ de nas lam sna 'khrid pa'i theg pa chen po'i bla ma dang mjal/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skye/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes 'byung*/ bdag tshe don yod par gyur ang snyam du yang yang 'byung*/ bsam pa bde 'bol ba skyes bu las zin pa lta bu 'byung*/ ji ltar byas kyang chos min pa gzhan bya mi dgos snyam pa la sogs pa du ma 'byung*/ rang gi sems la ji ltar skyes pa de bzhin gzhan la'ang de ltar snang ba 'ong*/ lam sna zin pa yin/ 'd-i'i dus su grogs ngan pa spang ba gal che/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs shing mya ngan las 'das pa la mdun ston pa rnams dang*/ skyo bsangs tsam zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bla'o ci rigs par bya/ nyon mongs pa 'phel ba'i gtam bcad/

res ri la 'gro/ res dben par yang bsdad/ nyon mongs pa rnam rtog gang gis sel blta zhing*/ gnyen po gang 'gro'i dgon pa bsten/ lar rtsa ba chod pa rang gi sems rtogs pas chog kyang bde shas chung na 'dug mi tshugs/ smra ba mang*/ sems 'tshig bza' rgyu la dga'/ lta kham che/ kha lta smra yang lkog mi thub/ sems la bltas pa'i dus su nges shes gting nas skyes pas/ sems la srog med/ dge sdig med/ skye shi med snyam pa 'byung*/ nges shes de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ de kho de ga bzhin byed na bar chad yin pas/ pho nya'am/ gtum mo 'bar 'dzag gam/ thig le'i rnam pa gang yang rung ba bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma dran par bya/ de ltar byas pas bde ba stong pa zung du chud pas/ pha bsad kyi mi dang phrad kyang zhe sdang mi skye/ thams cad bde chen gyi ngang du chud nas 'ong*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo shes/ tsher lcag gis brabs kyang na tsha chung*/ zugs thams cad dang bral/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad nye bar zhi/ sems rtog rkyang pa'i dus su 'od gsal yin yang zung du ma chud/ bde stong zung du ma chud pas zag bcas kyi bde ba sdug bsngal du go// sngar ni spros bral du rtogs pa yin/ da ni zung 'jug tu shar ba'o// des na bla ma'i zhal nas kyang gtum mo bsgom pa gal che gsung*/ shes bya'i gshis la 'di bas logs su mthar thug med kyang*/ nyams myong che chung 'di la gsung ba yin/ spros bral mthar thug pa'i dus su 'di las yar lhag pa gang yin yang*/ ye shes kyi rgyu ba chad ma chad brtag pa ci yin na snyam pa 'ong*/ cis kyang sgom chen gzhan thams cad khyad du gsod cing rlom dang bcas pa 'ong bas gzob dgos yod/ rlom pa ni nga rgyal yin la nga rgyal ni gzung 'dzin yin pas/ bdag 'dzin la sgro 'dogs chod snyam yang*/ da rung nyams la cung zad shor dogs yod/ glang po thon nas mjug ma ma thon pa lta bu'o// shes bya'i sgrib pa des nyon mongs pa kun nas blangs nas las gsog dogs yod/

de'i gnyen por mnar med pa'i dmyal ba nas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i bar gyi stong pa nyid la tha dad med pa la nga ci la nga rgyal snyam du gang ni bzang*/ gang ni ngan nga sgom bzang po can yin snyam na/ kha zas dug dang 'dres pa za ba dang 'dra snyam du yang bsam/ sgom bzang na nga rgyal dang rlom pa ga na 'ong*/ rang ngan pa yin snyam pa bsam pa la 'gro ba rigs drug ma lus pa rang gi lhag pa'i lhar bsgom zhing*/ rang sems la yang yang bltas pas snang stong zung du chud nas/ rang nyid dang gzhan tha dad med par yang go// snang stong gnyis zung du'ang chud/ de'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ngas ma rtogs pa ang snyam pa 'ong*/ chos zab pa dang rgya che ba rnams rang gi sems thog tu gdod do// 'di'i dus su rig pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen du tshur shar phar ma shor ba zhig dgos/ snang ba ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su'ang skye/ nga la yon tan du ma 'ong thang ba la snyam pa'i nges shes kyang 'byung*/ snang ba des sgyu mar yang 'ong*/ res 'od gsal du shar snyam byed/ res phan gnod med par snang ba tsam du yang 'dug de gsum gang bzang zhus pa la/ sems kyi rtsa ba gsha' mar chod na de gsum la bzang ngan med gsung*/ lar spros bral gyi dus su bla ma la mos gus dang*/ sems can la snying rje/ las rgyu 'bras la nan tan shin tu gal che/ chos kyi ngos nas khyad par med kyang*/ sems can gyi don 'grub mi 'grub dang*/ yon tan gong ma skye ba la khyad yod/ spros bral gyi dus su bogs 'don la dmigs pa mang du spo ba ngan/ 'dug pas bogs 'don pa yin te/ res ri dang brag la yang 'gro/ dran pa ma shor ba byas la/ bla 'o dang bgro gleng bya/ yul du ma'ang blta/ bla ma la mos gus dang*/ nges shes shin tu bskyed/ tshig dang tha snyad kyi spros par mi 'jug dbang yod na phal du ri dang*/ brag 'ba' zhig la rgyu zhing 'gro ba gal che gsung*/

chos kyi bshad pa mang po mi bya/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag ngus kyang*/ 'dod pa'i don grub nas lo bdun gyi bar du gnyid rmugs kyi rtog pa ma byung*/ bla ma mi las kyang*/ gangs dang ri 'ba' zhig la 'grims pa yin gsung*/ ma bsgoms par chos mi go// dge bshes rgya'i zhal nas/ 'di rgyu kun la chos ci 'dra ba yod pa yin na snyam pa la/ rang la skyes bu 'di 'dra ba byung gsung*/ chos skyes nas chos bsgom pa yin gsung*/ kho bo rang gis bltas pa la/ rgyu yod na tshogs gsog phra mo dang*/ maṇḍal dang yi ge brgya pa dang*/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang*/ bla ma spyi bor bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur brkyang pa de rnams kyang phan par tshor/ de rnams kyis slar la g.yengs na nyams ngan du yang 'gro/ grogs dam tshig gi grib yod pa dang sems bskyed dang dbang bskur lhan cig par byas nas/ grib kyis phog pa la tshegs med par yang go// lar dben pa bsten pa las skyid che ba med/ tshe thung nad mang*/ rkyen ngan mang bas dben par bsdad cing*/ sgom pa'i grogs 'dus byas kyi dge sbyor rang gang mos kyis gzengs bstod cing*/ sems la lta ba 'ba' zhig gal che/ tshe 'di'i gdos thag bcad gyur cing*// sgrub pa snying por byed pa ni// sgra brnyan gyi rlabs kyis mi g.yo zhing*// mtho dman gyi las la mi 'jug cing*// rnam rtog gi rta phos mi g.yeng bzhin// grogs ngan gyi grur yang mi zhugs la// tha snyad kyi chu bos mi 'khyer zhing*// nyams myong gi dben gnas bde chen du// dran pa zhen med kyi g.yog po bkol// re dogs med pa'i bza' rgyu drang*// rang sems gnyug ma'i bdud rtsi btung*// myong rgyu med pa'i bdud rtsis 'grangs// re dogs med pa'i sa ru nyal// chu bo bzhi yi rka mgo bshig /rgya mtsho chen po'i bug pa bsdam// med kyang ku re byas pa yin// nyams la mtho dman la sogs pa gang byung yang sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig mchod pas mchod/

gso ba thun re'am brgya rtsa brgyad re byed pa gal che/ nyam nga ba'am/ bag tsha ba byung na mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma thams cad spyan drangs la gang nyam nga ba dang*/ bag tsha na/ de bla ma rang du bsgoms pas 'phral la zhi nas 'ong*/ lar bogs 'don pa rnams la/ thabs shas che na shes rab kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab shas che na thabs kyis bogs 'don/ shes rab ni mnyam gzhag yin la/ thabs ni rjes kyi bya ba yin pas so// bla ma'i zhal nas spros bral rgyud la skyes nas/ kho rang bsgom pa gal che/ gzhan gang yang mi byed pa bogs 'don che shos yin gsungs so// spros bral de nyid bskyangs pa las/ ro gcig shar nas 'ong*/ lo dang zla ba du mar 'char du ma btub na/ rang nyid yi dam du bsgom zhing dmyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad blta/ de nyid sems su shes par byas la spros bral thun cig bsgom/ sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'i lha gnas thams cad blta/ de nyid sems su shes par byas la bsgom/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad blta/ de nyid sems su shes par byas la bsgom/ 'khor ba'i gnas lugs thams cad la blta/ de nyid sems su shes par byas la bsgom/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas lugs thams cad la blta/ de nyid sems su shes par byas la bsgom/ res 'ga' byang chub sems dpa'i gzigs mo sna rtse gsum la bslab par bya/ res 'ga' ri'i rtse mor phyin la phyag rgya chen po bsgom zhing snang ba la mig gis ngo sprad/ ngal gso zhing glod la bzhag bar bar du bla ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bsgom la rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzad du gsol zhes mos gus cher bya/ res 'ga' rlung thun re bsgom zhing snang ba la mig ha re blta/ gdams ngag gis snga ma bzhin du ro gcig tha ma skyes nas glod la bzhag pa gal che/ zab pa'i gsung rab blta ba gal che/ rtogs pa can gyi nyams myong gi mgur la sogs pa blta ba gal che/ 'di'i dus su dben pa bsten pa gal che/

bsgoms ma sgom khyad med par 'dug snyam yang sgom pa gnad du zab/ res 'ga' steng sgo la bsten pa yang gal che/ gtum mo 'bar 'dzag kyang bsgom/ rmi lam dang nyin par la khyad med du dran par byas na phan/ ji ltar byas kyang bogs thon du ma btub na/ tshe snga ma'am yang snga la dam tshig la sel yod pa'i rtags yin pas yi ge brgya pa mang du bya/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur bya/ de nas rang gi sems la blta zhing bsgom pas ro gcig mthar thug tu 'gro/ ro gcig gi rtogs pa dang nyams mthar thug kyang mngon par shes pa phra mo dang mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ma ma byung na dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa'i grib byung ba yin pas/ tshwa tshwa stong rtsa brgyad la sogs pa btab cing me tog re re phul la bdag gi sgrib pa nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// grib sel gyi gzungs chog gang yang rung ba bya/ dge ba'i sna ka gang dang gang yang rung ba byas na phan/ mtshan ma byung nas dga' mi dga' byung na bdud 'jug phan 'dogs pa dang gnod pa skyel ba dang bdud la sogs pa thams cad kyang rang gi sems yin/ sems nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa yin snyam du bsam/ lar ro gcig skyes nas rtog pa la mi 'jigs/ yon tan la mi dga'/ rkyen gyis kha khrid a cang mi nus pa yin yang*/ slar la phrag dog che nyon mongs mang*/ rnam rtog rags/ zur mgo rno/ dga' mi dga' che na bdud sems la zhugs nges pas dge sbyor la grims su bya'o// sgom dang mi mthun pa thams cad bdud du shes par bya/ bla ma dam pa dang 'grogs/ grogs chos rgyus can dang phrad la bla'o bya/ de'i dus su ngan ci zer ba thams cad nga la zer ba yin snyam na/ bla ma btud kyis btud la bsal thabs ci gsung mnyan/ bla ma rang gi gsung thams cad kyang tshig rtsub bam rang la ngan smras su go ba byung na bdag rang gis 'chos dgos te/ chos rtogs pa mtho ba dang rgyud tshod tha mal dang mnyam pa 'di yong ba min snyam du bsam/

mdo sde zab mo blta zhing rang gi rgyud tshod dang mthun mi mthun blta/ ro gcig skyes nas bdud 'ong ba cang 'thad dam snyam na/ rnam par rtog pa bdud yin te/ bdud 'jug pa logs nas med/ ces gsungs pas/ rnam rtog yod kyi bar la bdud 'jug pa yin pas/ sa drug man gyi nyan thos su song gi dogs pa yod gsung*/ de ltar byas shing bsgom pa las sgom med skye ste/ mnyam rjes rgyun chad med pa la sogs 'ong*/ mi stong pa'i dngos po'i skra'i rtse mo tsam yang med par mngon du 'gyur te/ 'di ni 'dren pa rnams kyi dam chos zad kyi dus// zhes gsung*/ gnyis med 'ba' zhig rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba/ nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba/ gser g.ya' dang bral ba/ rang sems bya byed dang bral ba'o// mar mes mun pa bsal ba bzhin// rnam rtog spang blang re dogs med// bde chen rgyal po'i gting du gnas// rnam rtog rlabs kyis bskyod pa med// chu bo bzhi ltar rgyun chad med// dran pa'i rkyen las rnam par grol// rin chen gling du phyin pa bzhin// spangs thob bzang ngan gnyis dang bral// mkha' la khyung chen lding ba bzhin// nyam nga 'bad rtsol gnyis dang bral// gang la seng ge gnas pa bzhin// bag tsha nyam nga gnyis dang bral// ri dwags rgya las shor ba bzhin// rmi lam snang ba tsam du med// 'jig rten rmi lam dag na'ang med// bu gcig shi ba'i ma

brjed yengs med par bzhin du// bde chen gsal snang 'ba' zhig skye// nad pas kha zas mthong ba bzhin// dngos po mtshan ma'ang de ltar go// rgyun chad med par nyams blangs na// dug kyang sman du 'gyur ba yin// tshe thung nad mang dal 'byor mi rtag pas// 'dod pa'i 'ching bas mi bzung zhing*// gnyen mdun gyi srung mas mi bskor bar// zhen gsum btang nas 'bad byas na// 'bras bu myur du 'byung ste mchi// mdor bsdus na ma yengs par bya zhing*// mi bsgom pa las gzhan med/ bogs 'don yang de che/ gegs sel yang de che/ bsrung ba yang de che'o// dge ba dri med gangs ri ltar dkar des// 'gro rnams phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog /rtogs pa dang thugs rje 'dres pa yi// bla ma sangs rgyas rje btsun gyi// zhabs pad btud nas gsol ba btab// thugs nyams kyi gdams ngag bdud rtsi de// mos gus lce yis blangs nas kyang*// tshe 'di'i ltos thag rab bcad nas// sgrub pa nan tan gtsor byas te// mchog gi dngos grub thob gyur nas// 'gro rnams bde la 'god par shog /rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams chen mo rdzogs so// // 678) ༄// rdzogs rim gsang ba bcud byung nā ro pa'i gdams pa// sems la gsum/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ tilli pa yi zhal nas/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// tilli ngas ni ci yang bstan du med// rang rig nyid la mtshon te shes par byos// zhes gsungs te/ kye ho zhes pa ni/ nā ro pa la 'bod pa'i tshig 'di ni zhes pa ni/ rang rig pa'i ye shes gnyug ma chos kyi sku 'di ni ngag gi smra ba'am/ brjod pa'i yul min zhing*/ yid kyi bsam pa'am/ blos brtag dpyad kyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ tilli pa ngas bstan du med pas/ nā ro pa khyod rang gi sems la khyod rang gis ltos la shes par byos gsung ba'o// gnyis pa lam ni/

tilli pa'i chos drug te/ mi bsam/ mi mno/ mi sems/ mi dpyad/ mi sgom/ sems ni yang dag nyid du rnam par grol ces gsungs pas/ de ltar nyams su blangs la de'i gegs sel ba dang*/ bogs 'don pa ni/ bcu chos kyis nyams su blangs bar bya'o// gsum pa 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni/ chos kyi sku thob la/ rgyas par ni man ngag so sor bstan zin no// gsang ba bcud phyung nā ro gdams pa 'di// chos rje'i thugs dam bla ma rnams kyi gsung*// gong mas bskul phyir bdag gis yi ger bkod// nor 'khrul byung na mkha' 'gros bzod par bzhes// gdams ngag nor bu'i phreng ba 'di// khrigs su bsgrigs nas thor bur bkod// ngo sprod bla ma'i zhal las shes// snod ldan gtong phod can la byin// snod min rnams la a dam rgya// nyams la byin na dmyal bar ltung*// de'i phyir gsang ba shin tu gces// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin thob shog/ // 679) ༄// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim rim lnga'i dmar khrid// na mo gu ru/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i rim pa lnga'i khrid bgyi ba'ang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ rim lnga'i smar khrid ma gtogs pa/ rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// grogs sgom chen tshogs na nga re brod// gsungs pa lags/ 'jig rten mgon pos kyang*/ dbon rin po che ma gtogs pa/ gzhan la ma gnang ba lags/ de la thog mar snying rje'i khrid 'di zla ba phyed mdzad pa lags pas/ 'khrul 'khor dky-il krung bca'/ lag pa sa gnon byas la/ snying rje'i dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor byed pa bzhin/ smin ma bsdus la/ mchi ma klog pa'i tshul du byas la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi ma yin ma rgan 'di rnams snying rje snyam du bsgom/ snying rje ba'i rgyu mtshan nyon mongs pas shes pa la rang dbang ma thob pa'i smyon pa lta bur 'dug pa des mi dge ba sna tshogs pa spyod cing 'dug

des sdug bsngal la bsran thabs med pa sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa nyams su myong ba 'dug pa/ de skyob pa'i mgon mi 'dug pas/ snying re rje snyam pa dung pa zhig bsgom mo// dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa na āḥ/ phyir 'byung ba na hūm̐/ yi ge de gsum po yod par bsgom pa'ang yin/ ngag tu bzla ba ma yin/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin du gnas pa yin la/ oṃ ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i snying po/ āḥni gsung gi snying po/ hūm̐ ni thugs kyi snying po/ yi ge gsum la sngags thams cad ma 'dus pa med pas/ ngag gi rig byed gang byed kyang bzlas pa ma yin pa gcig kyang med cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi snying por lhun gyis grub pas na/ lhun grub kyis bzlas pa zhes bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ ngag 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po de dbyer mi phyed pas/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba yin la/ gnyis pa ngag dben bya ba'ang yin gsung*/ gnyis pa sngon du 'gro ba byas nas/ sems rang lugs su glod nas bzhag pas/ rnam par rtog pa rags pa 'gags pa ni snang ba/ snang ba phra ba 'gags pa mched pa/ phra rags kyi rtog pa thams cad rgyun chad pa nye bar thob pa/ yang rtog pa med pa'i ngang nas rtog pa cig thol gyis skyes pa snang ba/ skad cig gnyis par mi sdod par hrig gis skye 'gag byed pa de mched pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyu ba rbad kyis chad pas na thob pa/ shes pa yul ma shar ba snang ba/ yul gyi spu ris phyed pa mched pa/ shes pa de chad nas yul gyi 'gyu ba chad pa thob pa/ gnas na gnas thog tu snang mched thob gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas rtog med du lhang nge*/ 'gyu na 'gyu thog tu snang mched thob gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas rtog med du lhang nge*/ shar na shar thog tu snang mched thob gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas rtog med du lhang nge*/

de ltar mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig las rtog pa btsal yang mi rnyed par 'dug pas/ de la dmigs pa sems kyi dben pa'o// gsum pa sgyu lus bsgom pa ni/ de ltar snang ba gsum gyi rtog pa bral ba'i sems de yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms pas/ snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad la sogs pa'i bdag med pas/ bdag las logs pa'i gzhan med par/ sems lus lta bu yin pas lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms pa'i mthar/ de tsam na phar phyin pa ltar na snang ba yin/ gsang sngags pa ltar na lus sems dbyer med du snang ba thams cad lha yi snang bar 'char te/ mdor na lus sems snang ba lha sku'i bdag nyid chen po zhig gi ngo bor 'char la/ de thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms te dmigs skor gsum pa'o// bzhi pa 'od gsal bsgom pa ste/ lus sems snang ba gsum lha'i sku ru snang ba de ril 'dzin nam rjes gzhig gis spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu la mnyam par bzhag go// lnga pa zung 'jug bsgom pa ste/ 'od gsal ci'i ngo bor ma grub pa bsgoms pa de'i ngang la yul sems snang ba gsum mdangs ma 'gags pa'i lha sku ru lam me ba la/ gshis ci yang mi yin pa 'od gsal gyi dngos gzhir gnas pa de gnyis su med pa zung 'jug tu kraung nge ba de rtse gcig tu byas la bsgom/ de la goms par bya ba yod kyi bar la slob pa'i zung 'jug goms par bya ba med na mi slob pa'i zung 'jug yin gsungs so// des rim lnga'i khrid tshar ba lags so// rim lnga'i tshar chos 'di gsungs/ de'ang spyir rim pa lnga bya ba 'di theg pa chen po gsang sngags/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor bla med/ de'i nang nas kyang bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi snying po lta bu yin/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ rim lnga'i dmar khrid ma gtogs pa'i// rdzogs rim brgya dang rtsa brgyad shes// gsung nas 'di rdzogs rim gyi khong du mi 'dzud de/

de tsam du thugs rtsis mdzad/ de la dang po rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ lus thams cad kyi mar sna/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum yod pas/ rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum las mi 'da'/ de yi ge gsum las mi 'da'/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs gsum las mi 'da' bas/ ngag tu brjod tshad 'bru gsum gyi bzlas par 'ong bas rdo rje'i bzlas pa zhes kyang bya/ lhun grub kyi bzlas pa zhes kyang bya/ des sems zin na tha mal gyi ngag gi rtog pa rgyun chad pas ngag dben pa zhes bya'o// rim pa gnyis pa sems la dmigs pa ni/ gnas skabs mthar thug tshe rabs skad cig ma'i sems gnyis phyi ma ste/ yul gang yang rung ba zhig cher mthong ba snang ba/ de la shes pa log gis log pa mched pa/ de nas khag gis 'gags pa nyer thob/ de la tha mal gyi rnam rtog rgyun chad/ mi rtog pa la lhan ne gnas pas sems dben gnas pa yin gsungs/ zhi gnas chos kyi phyag rgya dang yang lam gyi chod mnyam gsung*/ rim pa gsum pa sgyu ma lta bu ni/ snang gsum gyi rtog pas dben pa'i sems de yi dam gyi lha'i dngos gzhi der gnas pa bzhin/ lha bsgoms pas sems lus lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ lus lhar gsal ba byung ba de tsam na snang ba thams cad lus sems kyi snang ba yin pas lus sems snang ba gsum ga lha sku bdag nyid chen po zhig gi ngo bor 'char te/ snang ba rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu yin/ snang ba rang bzhin med pa yin/ dngos med stong pa phyogs gcig las log pa'o// rim pa bzhi pa 'od gsal ni/ sgyu ma lta bu 'di la ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gis thams cad stong pa 'od gsal du stong par bshad kyang*/ don la sgyu lus kyi lus sems snang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor de rim gyis je chung je phra la nam mkha' sprin dengs pa'am mtsho la 'khyag pa zhu ba'am/ me long la has btab pa bzhin 'od gsal snang med ci yang ma yin par 'jog pa de yin/

dngos po la mngon par zhen pa spongs ba yin/ rim pa lnga pa zung 'jug ni/ ji ltar chung klung dwangs pa las// nya dag myur du 'phar ba bzhin// thams cad stong pa 'od gsal las// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ 'od gsal snang med de'i ngang nas snang ba thams cad lha'i skur lam me de'i rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa de 'od gsal gyi dngos gzhir gnas/ dai gnyis su med par zung 'jug de la bsgom par byar yod kyi bar la slob pa'i zung 'jug goms par byar med na mi slob pa'i zung 'jug de la kha cig na re/ phar phyin pa'i lam gyi mthar thug zung 'jug 'od gsal gsang sngags kyi mthar thug yin zer te/ rtogs pa'i mthon dman yin gyi/ gang rung tha dad kyi dgongs pa yin zhes gsungs so// // 680) ༄// yan lag bdun chos dbang gi rgyal po gsal ba'i sgron me// 'khor 'das kun mgon rten 'brel kun la dbang*// shes bya rnams mkhyen rtag pa'i mtshan ma bral// 'phrin las dbang phyug nyi ma chen po'i lha// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen zhabs la 'dud// zab mo'i don la yi ge mi 'os kyang*// mang du ma thos brjed dogs yi ger bri// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che zhal nas/ spyir snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar go ma go'i khyad par du 'dus pa yin/ de la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i go ba ni/ rten 'brel 'byung zhes pa gsum yin te/ de'ang rten gang la brten na 'brel du dang 'brel bas/ 'byung ba gang dag 'byung*/ zhes pa gsum gyis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zhes bya ba yin no// de'ang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de'ang ma dag pa dang*/ cung zad dag pa dang*/ phal cher dag pa dang*/ shin tu dag pa dang bzhir 'gyur ba yin te/ mgon po byams pa'i zhal nas/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*// shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin// zhes gsungs so// de las ma dag pa 'khor ba'i duḥkha thams cad dang*/

rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ma dag pa la brten nas bskyed pa yin te/ ma dag pa'i rten ni rgya gar ram lho bal yan chad na nang pa'i rten gyi zla la dbang phyug chen po'i rten nam gzhan yang phyi rol pa'i rdo zur gsum mam tri shū la rdo sku lta bu la brten nas 'brel yan lag bdun du 'brel te/ de'ang phyag 'tshal ba dang 'brel/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdabs pa dang*/ rjes su bsngo ba dang 'brel lo// de rnams ji ltar 'brel na/ gong gi rten de rnams la dus bzang la sogs la ra dang ma he la sogs pa stong phrag mang po bsad nas mchod pa dang 'brel lo// mchod pa de ma grub pa la bshags pa byed pas bshags pa dang 'brel lo// mchod sbyin de gzhan byed pa mthong ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang 'brel/ gong gi mchod sbyin la sogs pa chos de gzhan yang bskul bas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang 'brel/ dbang phyug la sogs pa'i rten de'ang ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pas na/ mya ngan mi 'da' bar gsol ba dang 'brel/ de rnams kyang mthar thug dbang phyug chen po la sogs thob par bsngo bas rjes bsngo ba dang 'brel lo// de rnams dang 'brel bas/ 'byung ba gang 'byung na/ gong gi rten ma dag pa dang bsam pa ma dag pa bsgrub pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa ma dag pa de rnams dang 'brel bas/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 'byung*/ 'o skol bod na'ang ma dag pa'i rten bshan pa lta bu zhig la brten nas/ 'brel shin tu ma dag pa dang 'brel te/ 'bras bu dmyal ba'i duḥkha 'byung ngo gsung*/ de las cung zad dag pa ni/ ma dag pa ces pas/ 'bras bu lha mi'i bde ba don du gnyer ba yin te/ de ni so so'i skye bo bsnyen gnas bsrung ba lta bu zhig la mtshon na/

rten dkon mchog gsum la brten nas/ 'brel yan lag bdun gyis 'brel te/ de las dang po phyag 'tshal ba dang 'brel/ yul dkon mchog gsum la bsam pa lha mi'i bde ba thob par 'dod pas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ lha mi'i bde ba de thob par 'dod pas mchod pa la sogs byed pa dang*/ bsnyen gnas dang mchod pa ma grub pa la 'gyod nas bshags pa byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha mi'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa yod pa mthong na de la dga' ba bskyed pas rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ lha mi'i bde ba thob pa'i thabs de la gzhan yang bskul bas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ bsnyen gnas blangs pa'i yul dge bshes de yun du bzhugs na dga' bas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ de dag las byung ba'i dge ba de dag kyang lha mi'i bde ba thob pa'i don du bsngo ba byed pas rjes bsngo ba dang 'brel lo// de rnams dang 'brel bas 'byung ba lha mi'i bde ba 'byung ba yin no// des na 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar 'dus pa yin gsungs so// de las phal cher dag pa ni/ dag pa dang zhes pas/ 'bras bu nyan rang gi byang chub lta bu don gnyer ba yin te/ de'ang rten dkon mchog gsum la brten nas 'brel yan lag bdun gyis 'brel te/ yul rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i dkon mchog gsum la/ bsam pa rang kho na mya ngan las 'das pa thob 'dod kyi phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ nyan rang gi 'bras bu thob 'dod kyi mchod pa dang*/ de thob pa'i gegs su gyur pa'i sdig pa rnams spong ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas bshags pa dang*/ de lta bu'i 'bras bu thob pa dang*/ thob pa'i thabs la brtson pa rnams la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ 'gro ba gzhan rnams dang de lta bu thob par byed pa'i thabs la bskul ba dang*/ rten dkon mchog gsum de yun du bzhugs par gsol ba dang*/ dge ba de dag kyang rang don mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i don du bsngo ba ste/

rjes bsngo ba dang 'brel ba'o// de ltar yan lag bdun gyi tshul du 'brel bas/ 'byung ba nyan rang gi byang chub 'byung ba yin no// de dang de'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i che ba'am/ zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum gyi rten 'brel 'byung ba yin/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i rten 'brel ni/ shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin// zhes pas/ dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar 'dus pa yin te/ de la'ang mdo'i lugs kyis rten dkon mchog gsum la brten pa yin la/ 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin zhing*/ de las kyang bka' brgyud chen po 'di'i dbang du byas na mos gus kyi lam pa/ mos gus kyis bla ma bsgrub pa bya ba yin te/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa bgrod pa'i dmigs pa'i rten bla ma kho na yin la/ de la mos gus gal che bas/ mos gus lam gyi ngo bo yin/ de ltar mos gus bya ba'i rten bla ma de la gsum las/ dang po phyi'i bla ma ni/ rang dang zhal dngos su mjal zhing*/ chos dngos su nyan du yod pa 'di kho na yin/ nang gi bla ma ni rang gnas khang gzhan las tha dad pa zhig na 'dug kyang*/ rang gi mdun nam mkha' la seng ge'i khri dang nyi zla padma'i gdan gyi steng du bsgom pa de yin/ gsang ba'i bla ma ni/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i skabs de dang*/ gtum mo sgom pa'i dus su sgom pa de dang*/ 'od gsal gyi dus su sgom pa de dang*/ 'pho ba'i dus su sgom pa'i bla ma de nyid yin no// phyi'i bla ma de nyid dang yul thag ring pos bskal lam/ rang ri khrod lta bu la sgom du 'gro ba'am bla ma zhal mi bzhugs na/ bla ma de tur gyis dran pa'i rten sku 'bag gam/ zhabs rjes sam/ dbu skra 'am/ phyag sen nam/ zhabs sen la sogs pa'i rten zhig shin tu gal che ba yin/ mchod pa'ang rang la ci yod pa'i dngos po thog mar bla ma la 'bul dgos pa yin/

bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos rje'i dbu zhwa na dpal phag mo gru pa'i sku 'bag dngul las byas pa mtheb gang tsam zhig bzhugs pas/ 'bul ba ci tsam byung ba la/ dbu zhwa ma gsol bar yai mi bzhes gsungs/ bla ma rin po che 'bri gung na sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i dus su mtshan mo zhig chos zhur byon pas/ de'i nyin par dar mang po zhig 'bul ba byung ba/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ dpal chos ye la/ 'o skol kyi dar rnams mchod khang na dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i dngul sku bzhugs pa la 'bul dgos/ khyod kyis bcud len shes sam gsung*/ mi shes lags zer bas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rdzas yo byad ci yod pa dang*/ gzhan gyi 'bul ba ci byung yang*/ thog mar bla ma la phul bas/ tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa yin/ de nas rdzas des kyang phrin las kyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad thad kar 'grub pa yin te/ rdzas yo byad kyi bcud longs pa de ka la bcud len zer ba yin gsungs pas/ rin po che thugs dgongs la/ spyan snga ba'i nye gnas 'di rnams la de tsam re la brten nas chos zab mo mang po 'byon pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i gnas thams cad mi sbed par ston pa nye gnas 'di rnams kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'dug snyam du dgongs nas/ zhal du'ang de skad gsungs pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ khong gis khyed rnams la che bstod chen po mdzad gsung*/ mdor na rang la ci yod pa'i lus longs spyod thams cad gtsang sing gis phul na lus longs spyod kyi bcud longs pa yin gsungs/ bshags pa ni/ bla ma de thams cad mkhyen pa/ shes bya thams cad lkog tu ma gyur par mngon sum du mkhyen cing gzigs pa rang gi nyes skyon gsang nas zol byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs kyis mkhyen 'ong bas/ des na bla ma la snying gsha' ma bstan te/ bdag la skyon 'di dang 'di lta bu yod/ nyes pa 'di dang 'di lta bu shas che/ zhes pa la sogs pa ma gsangs par bshad la/

skyon gang yin pa ngag tu brjod nas/ de bla ma'i spyan sngar bshags dgos pa yin/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par thar pa dang*/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las la ngo mtshar che/ rjes su yi rang na snyam pa rjes su yi rang ba yin/ bla mas theg pa chen po'i chos mi gsung ba la/ gsung bar bskul ma 'debs shing*/ gzhan la phrag mi dog par thams cad kyis 'di lta bu'i chos zab mo khong du chud na dga' snyam pa bsam pa yin/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ thams cad kyi don du bla ma sku tshe shin tu ring ba 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byas pa thams cad bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir bsngo ba yin/ mdor na de rnams spyir bstan pa yin te/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung kho na yin/ chos 'di rang la blo gtad pa'i slob ma la bshad dgos/ de ma yin pa'i gar thod thod du mi bshad/ gtsigs shin tu che bar bya/ sngon ngas gdams ngag rtsis med byas shing en re tsam 'bar te/ da yang rtsis chung na zhu don med/ rtsis che ba ma lags sam/ so nam du mdzod la nan tan gyis kyin ma brjed par mdzod/ thun dang po'o// //'o skol bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub par 'dod pa rnams kyis dag pa rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ rnam par dag pa zhig gis rten 'brel bsgrigs shes pa zhig dgos te/ rten gang la brten na bla ma la brten/ 'brel gang gis 'brel na yan lag bdun gyis 'brel/ 'byung gang 'byung na de la brten pa'i yon tan 'byung ste/ de'ang bdun rnam dag gi dbang du byas na/ rten dmigs pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bskul ba dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bsngo ba'o// rten 'brel ltar na rten/ bdun rnam dag ltar na rten dmigs pa ni/

de'ang phyi nang gsang gsum du 'byung la/ de las phyi'i rten 'brel gyi rten bla ma ni zhal dngos su bzhugs pa de yin/ nang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i bla ma ni/ rang nyid kyi dmigs pa'i yul du gyur pa sems nyid bla mar snang ba rang gi bsam pa'i rang gzugs su mdun gyi nam mkha' la bsgom pa de nyid yin/ gsang ba rten 'brel gyi bla ma ni/ rdo rje'i lus 'di nyid 'khor lo stod smad du bsgom pa de nyid do// de las dang po phyi rten 'brel gyi bla ma de'i rten dran pa slong nus pa de gal shin tu che ste/ de'ang dbu skra la sogs pa'am/ zhabs rjes la sogs pa'i sku 'bag dran pa slong pa'am/ khyad par gyi rten re shin tu gal che ste/ med thabs med bya ba de spyi'i chings thun dang po snga ma'i don yin/ de la rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i rten bla ma de'-i sku 'bag gam/ zhabs rjes bzhengs pa de'i rgyu dngos po rnam par dag pa la bzhengs pa gal che ste/ de'ang dngos po rnam par dag pa gang yin na/ rab rin po che/ 'bring sman bzang po'am 'bru sna/ tha ma ras sam shing shun la byas pa yin te/ de'ang bla ma'i na bza' la sogs pa bla ma nyid kyi phyag nas byung ba/ gser la sogs pas bla ma dgyes pa'i dngos po rnam par dag pa'i rin gyis bsdus la bya ste/ rgyu de la'ang ngo so che ba zhig dgos pa yin/ rgyu rin po che dngos po dag pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di byang chub kyi sems las byung ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams na sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las rnam par dag pa las grub pas 'byung ba yin te/ de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ dper na snang ba rang gi sems dang*/ sems rang gi snang ba gnyis las/ snang ba rang gi sems ni rnal 'byor rtogs pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis snang ba thams cad sems su rtogs pa de nyid yin/ sems rang gi snang ba la gsum ste/ sems can gyi sems kyi snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa'am byang chub sems pa'i thugs kyi snang ba/

sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi snang ba rnams te/ sems can gyi sems kyi snang ba ni/ sems las nyon mongs pa zhe sdang drag po zhig skyes/ de yis las bsags/ las de las rnam par smin pa lcags sreg gi sa gzhi la sogs pa dmyal ba'i snang ba shar nas/ duḥkha dpag tu med pa myong ste/ de ltar nyon mongs pa gzhan gyis kyang*/ de ltar gang skyes pa de'i las bsags nas/ las kyi rnam smin tha dad du myong ba ni/ mi dge ba'i sems de ltar du snang bas na sems snang ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas na/ kun gzhi zhes bya ba byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyi gzhir gyur pas na kun gzhi zhes bya ba yin te/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de'i 'bras bu'am rnam par smin pa de'ang sa phyogs gang na gnas par der/ rin po che dang*/ sman bzang po dang*/ 'bru la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ste/ byang chub kyi sems de nyid las grub pa yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa rnams su'ang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa 'byung ba yang rgyu mtshan sngon du/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas sa lam sbyong ba'i dus na rten bzhaings pa la sogs pa la rin po che la sogs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i 'bras bu las byung ste/ snying rje padma dkar po las/ lha yi rgyal po tshangs pa na re/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nga'i yin no zer bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsan nas/ tshangs pa la bos nas/ khyod na re 'di skad zer ba bden nam gsungs pas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis de skad byas zer bas/ 'o na khyod kyi yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yod gsungs pas/ rgyu mtshan ni med de de skad byas pa tsam yin no zer bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di khyod kyi ma yin te/ nga byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i dus na/

dka' ba mang pos dag pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i 'bras bu yin no gsungs pas na/ de ltar zhing khams 'di na dngos po rnam par dag pa rin po che la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs las byung ba yin pas/ rin po che dngos po rnam par dag pa ste/ de'i phyir na rten chen po ma grub kyang rgyu dngos po bzang ba gal chai/

sngon rje rin po che 'bri gung du byon ma thag gsar pa'i dus na dpon yung la ba pa bya ba rdo sku mkhan zhig dang skyid shod du 'dris pas/ khong yang de na 'dug nas de la chos rje'i sku 'bag dbu zhwa'i nang du bzhugs pa zhig bzhengs par zhu dgos gsungs pas/ khong na re/ bdag gis zhabs tog byas pas mchi yis/ sngon la khyod rang gi chos rje la zhus shig zer nas/ spyan sngar zhus pas/ rten bya ba rgyu bzang ba dngos po dag pa la byed dgos pa yin/ dngos po dman pa la byar mi btub/ da lta rdo la bzhengs mi dgos/ phyis gser dngul las byas pa'i mchi gsungs nas/ der bkyon du kho na las ma byung ba las/ sang tshogs su bka' bkyon mang du byon te/ khyod bla ma'i sku shing la gyis/ khyi lud la gyis/ rten gyi rgyu'am gsung sngar gyi nyer len des nyes par 'dug snyam pa byung ste/ de chos rje'i thugs kyis mkhyen par 'dug ste/ phyis gser dngul las bzhengs pas chog pa byung gsungs/ des na rgyu che thod thod la bzhengs su mi btub ste/ nyes pa mang po 'byung ba yin pas/ dngos po bzang po rab gser dngul la sogs pa la bya ste/ de'i phyir na rgyu gang las bzhengs kyang*/ de'i gseb tu rin po che sna tshogs 'debs pa'ang rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ rgyu 'bring sman bzang po sna tshogs sam/ 'bru dang me tog dang tsan dan la sogs la byed pa yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis klu'i yul du byon nas/ tsan dan gor shi ṣa blangs te/ thugs dam sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs pa lta bu yin/ gzhan yang rdo rje gdan gyi jo bo byang chub chen po'ang sman bzang po'i lde gu 'ba' zhig la bzhengs pa yin par gda'/ tha ma ras sam shing shun la byed pa yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ ras kyi rgyu srin bal la cho ga byed pa nas bzung ste/ gnas skabs re re bzhin cho ga du ma gsungs/ bla ma'i na bza' la sogs pa'i don gong dang 'dra/

de lta bu'i rgyu gang yin pa la/ ras chog la sogs pa gang la'ang thar gyis thon par bya/ rgyu de rnams la bzhengs pa'i rkyen lha bzo yang*/ rab sprul pa'i lha bzo/ 'bring smon lam gyi stobs kyis byung ba/ tha ma 'tsho la ltos pa ste/ de'ang sdom pa dang ldan pa dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa thob pa/ rten gyi phyag tshad mkhas pa'o// de lta bu de zas dang gos kyi mnyes par byas la/ lha bzo mi bslu ba gal che ste/ de'i phyogs su song ba che ba zhig dgos pa yin/ de yang phyag tshad dang bzhugs thabs la sogs pa rnams ma 'phyug pa gal che ste tshad dang mi ldan na nyes pa mang po bskyed/ 'di las 'di 'byung bya ba 'khor lo sdom pa 'byung ba nas zhib tu gsungs so// bzhugs lugs nyes na'ang mi bzang ste/ sngon sgom chen pa zhig gis/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i sku 'bag bris sku zhig bzhengs nas/ de'i sku bzhengs pa phyag na 'khar ba bsnams pa/ phyag lham dang dbu zhwa gsol ba zhig khyer nas chos rje rin po che la rab gnas zhu zer bas/ rab gnas ma gnang bar bka' bkyon mdzad de/ khyod blo she rgod/ 'gro 'dug la dga'/ khyod kyi lha yang 'di 'dra ba gsung*/ des na sku de phyogs gang nas kyang legs dgos te/ bzhugs gdan chung na'ang yul der mi shong*/ khri de chung na'ang gdan sa la sogs mi non pa yin/ mthar gzar na yul gyi bcud phyir la 'bo/ padma yo na gnas der mi chags/ dma' ba tshe thung*/ mtho na 'khrugs pa 'chor/ lha'i 'khor kun chung na 'khor ngan/ zheng kha phra ches na'ang mi 'chun pa yin/ bris sku lta bu yin na/ gtso bo'i steng na phar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bri bar bya ste/ rang gi bla ma de nyid dbu'i thad ka'i dbus su bri bar bya'o// yi dam dang 'dod lha thams cad sku'i g.yas g.yon du bri bar bya ste/ pha rgyud kyi lha thams cad g.yas su bri/ ma rgyud kyi lha thams cad g.yon du bri bar bya'o// 'jig rten pa rnams ni gdan khri'i 'og tu bri'o// ma mgon gnyis ni gdan khri'i 'og zur g.yas g.yon gnyis su/

gtso bo'i spyan 'og tu tshud tsam du bri ste/ de'i dgos pa ni/ gdan khri'i 'og tu tshud drag na non pas nus pa mi 'byung*/ de las 'gyangs na 'chun pa dka' bas/ spyan 'og tu tshud tsam du cis kyang byed dgos pa yin/ sku 'bag gser sku lta bu yin na/ khang pa ka bzhi ma'i dbus gdan khri khru gang tsam gyi steng du bzhugs pa'i spyan 'og tu them pa tshud tsam gyis spyan dpangs su bya/ des na bkod pa la mkhas dgos pa yin gsungs so// de la'ang rab tu gnas pa gal che ste/ de'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ rab bla ma sangs rgyas// 'bring grub thob/ tha ma'ang btsun pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ cho ga la mkhas pa zhig dgos te/ gang thod thod kyis mi 'ong*/ rten mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de lha sa'i jo bo shākya lta bu yin te/ dngos po rnam par dag pa rin po che sna bcu las byas pa bzo bo bi shwa karmas byas pa/ yon bdag lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byas pa/ rab gnas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis mdzad pa yin te/ de lta bu shin tu dka'/ des rab gnas mkhan po de/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyan 'drongs pa/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug nus pa zhig dgos pa yin/ mdor na rab tu gnas pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par byas pa'i rten de 'o brgyal ba chags grugs dang nag nog la sogs pa ma song bar bya/ de lta bu song na gang song thad kar na tsha la sogs pa 'ong bar 'dug sngon bla ma me nyag gi nye gnas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan ske na ste spyan sngar zhus pas/ bla ma mi nyag gi sku 'bag spyan drongs gsung*/ spyan drangs pas sku 'bag gi mgul na snum thig shor nas 'dug der snum de 'don pa'i thabs byas pa rang gi drags gsung*/ de'i phyir na gzab pa gal che ba yin/ des na bzhugs sa yang gang zag gi khams rigs dang bstun pa gal che/ me rlung khams shas che zhing*/ shes pa mi gnas pa'i rigs rnams la/ rten bzhugs sa mthos na slar thur du 'gro/ mi sa khams shas che ba rnams la rten bzhugs sa dmas na slar thur 'gro bas/

bzhugs sa'ang mtho dman ran pa gal che ba yin/ des rten cing 'brel par bla ma'i rten bzhengs pa'o// thun mtshams gnyis pa'o// ༈ //shin tu rnam par dag pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ bla ma'i mos gus kyis lam bgrod par byed pa rnams kyi rten bla ma la brten/ 'brel bdun rnam par dag pas 'brel te/ yon tan gyi tshogs ma lus pa 'byung ba yin pas/ bla ma dang 'brel pa zab pa gal che'o// de la rten bla ma'i dmigs pa la brten nas/ mchod pa dang 'brel bas de la gsum ste/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i mchod pa dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i mchod pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang gi mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// dang po ni me tog la sogs pa lnga'o// chos gang nyams su len pa dang 'di dang 'brel dgos te/ mdo'i lugs dang sngags kyi lugs/ mdo'i rjes su 'brangs pas sngags ltar byed pa yin/ bla ma'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'brang na/ mchod pa rnam lnga rgyun du ma chags pa byed dgos/ nga yang grogs po bzang po'i drin gyis/ 'di dkyus su chud pa yin te/ sngon dpal chos ye tsā ri la phyin pas/ khong nyin re la rnam lnga ma chag par lan gsum byed cing snang bas/ ngas kyang dang po ma 'dzom tsam byung yang*/ byas pa rang gis phyis nas da lta'i bar yan chad rgyun ma chad par phul ba yin/ 'di bzhin du phul bas sangs rgyas pa'i dus su/ zhing der me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i khyad par rgyun ma chad par 'byung ba yin/ de las dang po me tog la sogs pa thams cad la/ spyir shes bya la me tog 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ de ji ltar 'bul ba'i thabs dang*/ phul bas yon tan 'byung tshul lo// dang po phyi rol tu me tog 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan la gnyis te/ mdo dang*/ sngags lugs so// dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa sangs rgyas thub pa chen po des/

sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i dus na me tog gcig pu la brten nas kyang rang gi bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas snga ma rnams la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags pas/ khong sangs rgyas pa'i zhing 'dir me tog mi 'byung ba kha med/ gnyis pa sngags ltar na/ phyi nang thams cad gnad gcig pa yin pas/ dwangs ma'i dwangs ma 'bul bar bya/ zhes pas na rdo rje'i lus 'di la'ang 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma/ don snying lnga me tog tu yod par bshad mchin pa sa yi me tog glo ba chu'i me tog snying me yi me tog mtsher pa rlung gi me tog mkhal ma nam mkha'i me tog yang na mig sa'i/ rna ba rlung gi/ sna nam mkha'i/ lce me'i/ lus chu'i me tog go// phyi rol tu'ang 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma me tog mi 'byung kha med pa yin/ gzhan yang mdo ltar na 'byung ba bzhi yi dwangs ma me tog tu 'ong bar bshad/ de me'i dwangs ma dmar po 'ong bar bshad/ sa'i dwangs ma ser po/ chu'i dwangs ma dkar po/ rlung gi dwangs ma sngon por 'byung ngo*// yang na 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs ma las mchod pa'i lha mo me tog mar bshad de/ 'byung ba bzhi dwangs ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sos ka 'byung ba me dar ba'i dus su sa gzhi la drod phebs shing*/ sos ka tshad pa che ba'i dus su/ me'i dwangs ma khug chos la sogs pa dmar po dar ba yin no// de nas thams cad 'bol 'byung ba yin te/ sa dar ba'i dus me tog ser chen la sogs pa ser po rnams dar ba yin no// dbyar 'bru char chu 'brub ste/ chu dar ba'i dus su puṇḍa ri ka dkar po rnams dar ba yin/ gzhan yang me tog rnams kyang skya shas chen por 'gyur ro// ston ser kha rlung dar ba yin pas spangs rgyan la sogs pa'i me tog sngon po rnams dar ba'i dus yin rlung gi dwangs ma yin/ mdor na nam zla dang dus kyang mi 'phyug par 'byung ba yin no/ /'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ ma mā ki dang u ti ka

me tog ka ra wi ra sam/ zhes gsungs de'i don bshad rgyud du dris lan gsungs pa me tog ces ni gang la bya/ zhes dris pas lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams// me tog ces ni bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ lha mo rnams me tog tu 'ong bar bshad do// gnyis pa dbul ba'i thabs la gnyis te/ mthar thug tu sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i ched du 'bul ba dang*/ gnas skabs su phrin las bzhi 'grub pa'i don du 'bul ba'o// dang po ni zhing bla ma sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo la/ dngos po rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems kyis rang gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo yis dbul ba yin te/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ rin chen byang chub sems las byung gyur cing*// chos kun gdod nas zhi bas shes rab kyis// 'phags pa mchod cing sems can smin mdzad pa'i// kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung mchog /mchod rdzas mtha' yas dpag tu med pa yis// rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kun bkang nas ni// bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gsum la 'bul// zhes gsungs pas/ zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum ga rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su byas nas gsol ba btab na gang 'dod thams cad 'grub pa yin te/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum// gcig tu byas nas gsol ba gdab// bar chad gsum dang bral gyur na// ci 'dod 'bras bu myur du 'byung*// zhes gsungs/ de ltar bla ma la me tog 'bul ba gal che ba yin te/ 'bri gung kun na dbyar ka me tog bla ye khrig khrig pa 'bul du 'ong*/ de nye gnas kun la spyan sngar bsgrigs tu bcug par 'dug ste/ res zlum por 'god/ res gru bzhi/ res zla gam du 'god/ mdor na dbyibs kyi khyad par sna tshogs su 'god/ rten 'brel du ma bsgrigs par gda'/ de'i dus na thugs rtsis che bar mdzad de/

grib skam byas nas tshugs pa mang po bkang ste/ phyis kyi mchod rdzas kyang mdzad/ 'di kun ni me tog 'bul mi dgos khu tshur sgril ba rang gi chog gsungs nas cung zad bkyon/ grub tshad du dam bcas nas phul na/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa sgrub dgos pa'i mchod rdzas kun kyang 'bul du 'ong bar 'dug ste/ sngon chos rje la rgya gar du 'gro bar zhus pas ma gnang*/ nan cher zhus pas/ khyed ci nas kyang mi gsan par bzhud na/ rdo rje gdan na slob dpon klu sgrub kyis btsugs pa/ me tog tsam pa ka'i sdong po yod pa 'dug pas/ de nas me tog gcig longs la skur cig gsung nas/ sgom pa gsal ba dbang phyug dang*/ sgom pa shes rab gnyis la/ gser zho lnga bcu tsam bskur te byung nas 'gro bar brtsam pas/ sgom she 'di'i tsab tsub cig gis ma thon/ dus skabs shig tu de ston brin tshong dus su ras sgrub tu btang bas/ a tsa ra zhig dang phrad de/ de'i lag nas sngar gyi me tog byung nas/ de lta bu spyan sngar 'bul du byung*/ bod kyi tsam pa ka spra dog pa 'di dang mi mthun te/ ga'ur bcun pa kha phye ba'i dris kyang rgyang ring po khyab pa zhing 'ong gsung*/ gnyis pa thun mong du 'phrin las bzhi bsgrub na/ rang la na tsha drag po byung na'ang*/ zhing bla ma de bcom ldan 'das rnam snang sku mdog dkar por bsgom/ tsam pa ka la sogs pa me tog dkar po dri zhim zhing nus pa rmad du byung ba dbyibs zlum por bkod pa dbul te/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la nad zhi bar gsol ba drag po yang yang btab na nges par zhi bar 'gyur te/ sngon nga la phyi na yod pa'i dus na/ 'khor na dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po zhig shangs khrag byung nas/ sman dang*/ sngags la sogs pa gang gis kyang ma chod par ser mal gyis song*/ de'i dus na/ bdun chos kyi gnad 'di sngan chad tha ma nyag nyug bshad cing yod pa las/ khong la rten 'brel 'di bslabs te/ 'dis ma phan na da phyin chad mi shod gsung*/

khong gis 'di nyams su blangs pas sang rang la drag nas gda'/ blo nges pa byas na ci yin yang 'grub par 'dug ste/ rten 'brel yang de rang*/ dmigs pa yang de rang*/ sman yang de rang*/ sngags kyang de rang zab pa 'dug ste/ rgyas pa dang dbang la sogs pa'i las gzhan rnams la'ang*/ me tog dri zhim nus pa rmad du gyur pa kha dog rang rang gi rigs dang mthun pa/ ser po/ dmar po/ dbyibs gru bzhi dang zla gam/ zhing bla ma rin 'byung dang*/ snang mtha' rang gi kha dog can bsams te/ kha'i ston phyogs rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar byas la/ 'di dang 'di 'grub par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba drag du btab na/ gang yin pa de 'grub par nges pa yin/ sngags pa mthu byed pa kun la me tog sngon po dang*/ nag po kho na dgos par bshad nas 'dug mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyi// kha dog mdangs dang mi ldan spangs phyir dang*// mtshan dang dpe byad 'od 'bar thob bya'i phyir// bdag gis khyed la me tog dbul bar bgyi// puṣpe/ gsum pa phul nas yon tan 'byung tshul la/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go// gnas skabs ni/ rang la gzhan gyis me tog 'thor ba 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan gyis rten khyad par can la me tog 'thor ba 'chol ba 'byung zhing*/ de la'ang rten la me tog chags pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar che ba'i rtags 'byung ba dang*/ skye ba gzhan du'ang gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ dri zhim zhing sha 'jam pa kha dog legs pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// mthar thug rang nyid sangasargyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der/ me tog gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'byung zhing*/ lha rnams kyis kyang me tog kha dog dang*/ dri phun sum tshogs pa pus nub tsam du 'thor ba 'byung bar gsungs te/ de ni me tog gi don bshad pa yin no// thun gsum pa'o// //de bzhin du spos la'ang don gsum ste/ spos dang sman la sogs pa 'di rnams/ so nam rmo bkol ba la sogs pa ma byas par 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/

de tshul ji ltar dbul ba dang*/ yon tan 'byung tshul lo// dang po la gnyis te/ mdo lugs gong dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ nang rdo rje lus la ji ltar yod pa bzhin du/ de'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol tu de dang mtshungs par mi 'ong kha med pa yin te/ rdo rje'i lus 'di la 'byung ba bzhi dwangs ma las nang na snying la sogs pa'i don snying lnga yod pas/ phyi rol tu'ang ba mkhal smug po dang*/ mkhal ma dre'o dang*/ glo go yu dang*/ snying zho sha dang*/ ra mdzer la sogs pa/ spos kyang yin sman yang yin gsung*/ thad ka thad kar phyi rol gyi nad rnams la'ang phan/ yang na nang rdo rje'i lus 'di la thig le dkar dmar ngo bo bsil bar gnas te/ rgyud nas ming yang tsan dan ga pur zer te/ de bzhin phyi rol tu'ang tsan dan ga pur 'byung ba yin te/ nad grang ba las phyi rol gyi ga pur btang na bsil ba dang phrad pas 'byung ba chu rgyas te/ 'byung ba ro ma snyoms na nad drag po 'byung zhing 'chi bar 'gyur ba'o// de'i phyi spos reng bu dang 'bul spos la sogs pa/ spos sbyor rnams kyang nang gi 'byung ba cha snyoms pa'i phyir/ gcig gi cha gcig gis mnan na cha snyoms pa yin/ spyan snga nas bco lnga spos kyi sbyor ba mdzad pa kun kyang*/ nor 'khrul med par zho la btegs nas shin tu mnyam ste/ de'ang nang gi 'byung ba cha snyoms pa'i rten 'brel yin pa'i gshis su 'dug bco lnga spos kyi sbyor ba 'di la'ang*/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i sman sgrub dang don mtshungs par 'dug ste/ sman sgrub de'ang ma legs na bkra mi shis pa'i ltas rul pa dang*/ khyi ro la sogs pa 'byung ste/ de byung bas nyes pa mang po 'byung la/ legs na ltas bzang po 'byung zhing*/ dngos grub mang po 'byung bar gda'/ de bzhin du spos sbyor 'di la'ang sbyor ba'i thabs/ snyoms thabs dang gos gtsang ma la sogs pa thar gyis then pa byed pa yin/ langs pa'i dus na dri mi zhim pa sogs byung na/

nyes pa mang po 'byung ste/ legs par gyur na phan bde mang po 'byung bar 'dug sbyar legs pa'i dri des khams snyoms pa dang ba'i dad pa skye la/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i grogs su'ang 'gyur/ 'di'i lung sangs rgyas phal po che na bzhugs te gzhon nu nor bzang gis/ tshong dpon utpala'i mdog la chos zhus pas/ tshong dpon na re/ rigs kyi bu ngas spos sbyor legs pa zhig shes pa yin gyis gzhan ci yang mi shes so// zer nas/ spos sbyor zhus pas/ tshong dpon na re/ ngas byang chub kyi sems dpa' rnam pa gnyis rgyud la bskyed pa'i spos sbyor shes/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po skye ba dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i spos sbyor shes/ rnga dang*/ dung dang*/ rol mo la rgyab pas/ de'i sgra thos pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob pa'i spos sbyor shes/ de bzhin du lha dang mi dang klu dang lha min dang*/ dri za dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ grul bum la sogs pa dga' ba'i spos sbyor shes so// ngas ni de las ston par nus re kan gsung*/ de'ang don 'di lta bu yin te/ kha non med par gla rtsi la sogs pa sna re bsreg tu mi btub ste/ bsreg na sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i klu dang thug nas/ rang la'ang nyes pa mang po 'byung bar 'dug gzhan yang khrag rul ba la sogs pa'i dngos po ngan pa gla rtsi'i 'phro zhig yod pa de la gzigs pas/ gla rtsi de khrag gi lhad yod pa zhig yin 'dug des lan par gda' gsung*/ yang rtsub pa nang sbyar na'ang mi legs te/ dza ti lta bu sha stag sbyar na'ang 'thab mo 'ong bar 'dug /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i spos sbyor sum cu pa nas/ re'u mig byas te/ 'di'i rjes su 'brang na rtsub par 'gyur/ 'di'i rjes su 'brang na 'jam par 'gyur gyi sdebs bshad pas/ bcu drug pa brgyad pa phyag bzhes ltar bya'o// gnyis pa 'bul ba'i thabs la gnyis te/

mthar thug dang gnas skabs so// dang po ni/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel bsgrigs shes pa'i sgo nas/ legs par sbyar ba'i spos kyi bye brag rnams/ rgya rab 'jig rten khams khyab pa/ dus chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ byed las 'phags pa mchod cing*/ sems can smin par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam pa'i dngos po de/ zhing rnam par dag pa bla ma sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo la/ bsam pa sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blos/ ngag tu'ang*/ mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyis// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs phyir dang*// chos kyi shes rab dri med thob bya'i phyir// bdag gis khyed la bdug spos 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod nas/ gsol ba drag po 'debs pa yin no// de'ang zhing bsam dngos gsum dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ gsol ba gang btab 'grub pa ste/ de'ang zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum zhes pa la sogs pa'o// de'ang badzra stong pa/ dhu pe snang ba/ āḥhūm̐ gnyis su med pa'i don te/ don de lta bus mchod par byed pa yin/ gnyis pa 'phrin las bzhi dang bstun nas 'bul ba ni/ zhing bla ma sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po'am/ yang na las so so la shes pa'i lhar bsgom ste/ spos kha dog dkar ser dmar sngo bzhi/ spos rgya sgor mo/ gru bzhi/ zla gam/ gru gsum mo// sman 'bul na dkar ser dmar sngo'o// bsam pa gang 'dod pa bstun nas gsol ba gdab pa'o// phul ba'i yon tan ni gnas skabs su las so so'i gsol ba btab pa 'byung ba dang*/ tshe rabs gzhan du'ang lus la dri zhim po bro ba dang*/ phyogs thams cad du snyan pas khyab pa 'byung*/ mthar thug sman bla lta bur sangs rgyas nas/ tshul khrims kyi dri ngad kyi sangs rgyas pa'i zhing der yang spos dang sman ga pur tsan dan la sogs pa grangs med pa 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan gyis kyang de lta bus mchod par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas pa'i zhing de'ang spos nas gras pa zhig 'byung ba yin/

gzhan du na spos rang la chos thun cig yod par gsungs// //mar me'i don bstan pa la gsum ste/ zhing 'dir snang gsal khyad par nyi zla dang*/ rin po che sgron ma dang*/ rtsi mar dang*/ 'bru mar la sogs pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ dbul ba'i thabs dang phul ba'i yon tan 'byung tshul lo/ dang po zhing 'dir snang gsal gyi bye brag rnams 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdo dang sngags gnyis las/ dang po byang chub kyi sems gnyis las byung zhing*/ sangs rgyas 'di byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i dus na/ bla ma'am/ sangs rgyas snga ma rnams la dngos po de lta bu phul ba las byung ba yin no// gnyis pa sngags ltar na/ nang rdo rje'i lus la rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma yod pas/ phyi rol tu 'bru mar rtsi mar la sogs pa'i mar me mi 'byung ba kha med yin/ phyi nang gnad gcig pa'i go ba dang*/ snang sems gcig tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa tshul ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul ni gnyis las/ dang po mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas 'bul ba ni/ zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub thob par 'dod pas 'bul ba ste/ mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad kyis// ma rig mun pa thams cad spang phyir dang*// zag med snang ba'i shes rab thob bya'i phyir// bdag gis khyed la snang gsal 'bul bar bgyi// zhes pas dbul te gong dang 'dra/ gnyis pa thun mong du 'phrin las bzhi dang bstun nas dbul ba ni/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi las kong bu zlum po/ gru bzhi/ zla gam/ gru gsum dag tu/ rtsi mar/ 'bru mar/ til mar/ zhun chen gyi mar khu byas la/ zhing bla ma de las so so'i lhar bskyed/ las so so'i phyogs su kha bstan te/ gang dang gang du sgrub pa de mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab na 'grub par 'gyur ro// yang 'phrin las bzhi ka'ang kong bu gcig la sgrub tu rung gsung*/ yang ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i rten 'brel yang yin te/
'od gsal sgom pa'i dus na nges par mar me 'bul dgos pa yin/
